_comment: Hand-curated corrections layered on top of the Semantic Scholar fetch. 'patches' fix notes/author formatting (co-first/corresponding marks the API doesn't know about) on papers the API does return, matched by normalized title. 'extra' are full manual entries for things the API has no record of (e.g. conference abstracts without a DOI). 'exclude_titles' drops API entries that shouldn't render at all.
